notes_for_editor: Forest conflict: the register says Modoc National Forest, while the July 1930 Klamath News item says the point lies in the Shasta forest but is run by Modoc officers; both are reported in the story. Brief checks: elevation_m 1578.9 matches the register's 5,180 ft (1,579 m);the peakbagging page gives 5,256 ft, which is not reconciled, so the story gives both. The 1930 Klamath News item (construction to start) does not match the register's 1937 build date; the sources do not say whether the 1930 work happened or was delayed. The register says rebuilt in 1956, the peakbagging page says rework or repairs in 1956. Present public access is not in any source read (a Forest Service directions note linked from the peakbagging page was not located), so no access fact is recorded. Staffing is from the register (undated) and a peakbagging note (photo captions from 2006 and 2012). No photos added: the register and peakbagging photos were not fetched as image URLs. The 1930 road description is quoted as a historic account only. The brief's kind two_story was not changed; the register's cab-on-block-tower description is not clear enough to correct it. Fact-check 2026-10-08: footnotes added to the county-line sentence and the 1930 road sentence; 'living out of a tent' follows the peakbagging wording; 'design' removed from the BC-301 description, which the register does not use; the story now says 'current lookout' where it had said 'current cab'.
